cards.name: Adventure Camps
cards.description: Campers participate in outdoor adventure activities in age-appropriate groups at the Adventure Center of Asheville.

special_needs.text: Kolo Bike Camp and Adventure Camp are not therapeutic programs and are not appropriate choices for youth dealing with behavioral, motivational, or rehabilitation issues. If you are unsure if your camper would be suited for our camps, please reach out to our Camp Director (camps@adventurecenterofasheville.com)and we would be happy to talk more about our program and what we can offer.

cards.name: Kolo Bike Park Camps
cards.description: Campers ride mountain bikes and receive bike instruction at Kolo Bike Park. Campers must be comfortable riding a pedal bike off-road.
